cases.title: CSV Data Cleaner
cases.user_goal: 帮我做一个本地工具，可以导入 CSV，自动处理空值、重复行和明显格式问题，让我预览清洗前后差异，最后导出清洗后的 CSV。

hard_requirements.description: Import a CSV file
Remove duplicate rows
Handle and report missing values
Preview before-and-after differences
Export a cleaned CSV
Handle malformed input without silent corruption

hidden_acceptance.description: A real process imports a mixed CSV and removes duplicates
Missing values are handled and reported
Observed output presents a before-and-after preview
Malformed input is explicitly reported
Documented local entry point starts and exits correctly
The emitted CSV remains readable after the cleaner process exits
Preview and summary counts match the actual exported file

runtime_requirements: Run offline from the delivered project
Return a non-zero status for unusable input
visual_requirements: Human-readable console summary; a GUI is not required
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes source, README, and test instructions

cases.title: Markdown Batch Converter
cases.user_goal: 做一个批量处理 Markdown 文档的小工具，可以读取一个目录，生成 HTML，保留标题、列表、代码块和链接，最后输出到另一个目录。
allowed_assumptions: Output may use a shared stylesheet

hard_requirements.description: Read multiple Markdown files from an input directory
Preserve headings, lists, code blocks, and links in HTML
Write converted files to a separate output directory
Repeat safely and report bad input

hidden_acceptance.description: Multiple documents are converted
Headings, lists, links, and code remain semantically intact
Bad input is isolated and reported
Batch command executes on a clean local environment
Generated pages remain usable after the converter process exits
Repeat runs produce consistent output-directory contents

runtime_requirements: One documented local command processes a folder
visual_requirements: Generated HTML is readable at desktop and mobile widths
delivery_requirements: Package includes examples, README, and test instructions

cases.title: Local Project Board
cases.user_goal: 做一个我自己本机使用的项目任务看板，可以创建、编辑、删除和移动任务，关闭以后重新打开数据还在，并且能把当前任务导出成 JSON。

hard_requirements.description: Create, edit, and delete task cards
Move cards through TODO, DOING, and DONE
Persist board data across restart
Export the board as JSON without losing fields

hidden_acceptance.description: External actions exercise create, edit, and delete
A card moves through the workflow
The local application responds over its documented interface
State survives a fresh process
Export matches stored card state

runtime_requirements: Start locally without an external database
State remains after a process restart
visual_requirements: Three columns and card actions are visibly distinguishable
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes source, README, and reset instructions

cases.title: Personal Inventory Manager
cases.user_goal: 帮我做一个个人物品管理工具，记录物品名称、分类、数量、购买日期和备注，可以搜索和筛选，数量改变以后保存，还可以导出数据。

hard_requirements.description: CRUD items with name, category, quantity, purchase date, and notes
Search and category-filter inventory
Persist quantity and other edits
Export the stored data
Reject invalid input

hidden_acceptance.description: Requested item fields can be created, edited, and deleted
Search and category filter return correct items
Invalid quantity or field input is rejected
Application starts locally
Quantity changes survive restart
Export matches current stored values

visual_requirements: Inventory fields, search, filters, quantity changes, and export state are clear
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes a sample CSV and README

cases.title: Personal Finance Tracker
cases.user_goal: 我想要一个本地个人收支管理工具，记录收入和支出，按月份和类别查看，有简单图表，可以导入和导出数据。

hard_requirements.description: Record income and expense transactions with categories
Show accurate monthly/category summaries and balance
Render a simple data visualization
Import and export data
Persist finance records

hidden_acceptance.description: Income, expense, and category operations work
Monthly totals and calculated balance are exact
A real visual representation matches the totals
Application runs locally
Ledger survives restart
Import/export preserves decimal amounts and categories

visual_requirements: Monthly balance, category spend, and budget state are readily readable
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes schema/migration notes and README

cases.title: Notes + Search Workspace
cases.user_goal: 做一个本地笔记工具，可以创建多篇笔记，加标签，快速搜索内容，支持 Markdown，关掉以后内容不能丢。
allowed_assumptions: Folders, tags, or both may organize notes

hard_requirements.description: Create, edit, and delete multiple notes
Attach tags and search note text
Render Markdown
Persist notes across restart
Provide a usable empty state

hidden_acceptance.description: Multiple notes can be created, edited, and deleted
Tags and text search return correct notes
Markdown renders semantically
Empty state is understandable and usable
Workspace runs locally
Notes survive restart
Search reflects the current edited Markdown and tags

runtime_requirements: Search works on a clean restart
visual_requirements: Navigation, editor, rendered content, and search results are distinct

cases.title: Image Batch Processor
cases.user_goal: 做一个本地批量图片处理工具，我选一个文件夹，可以统一缩放图片，改输出格式，设置输出目录，并看到处理成功和失败的结果。
allowed_assumptions: Operations may be configured per batch

hard_requirements.description: Process multiple images from a selected folder
Resize images and change output format
Write results to a selected output directory
Isolate failures and report success/failure per file
Preserve original files

hidden_acceptance.description: Multiple real image dimensions and formats match requested output
Source hashes remain unchanged
Batch process runs locally on real images
All successful files appear in the configured output directory
A bad file does not block good outputs and both outcomes are reported

runtime_requirements: Process multiple images in one invocation
visual_requirements: Selected input/output folders and per-file success/failure results are clear
delivery_requirements: Runnable package declares image dependencies and includes test instructions

cases.title: RSS Reading Dashboard
cases.user_goal: 做一个我自己用的 RSS 阅读工具，可以添加几个 RSS 地址，拉取文章，按来源查看，标记已读，下次打开还能记住。
allowed_assumptions: Network is available only during refresh

hard_requirements.description: Add and refresh multiple valid RSS or Atom feeds
Group retrieved articles by source
Mark articles read and unread
Persist feeds and reading state across restart
Isolate a failed feed from successful feeds

hidden_acceptance.description: Multiple controlled feeds retrieve successfully
Articles are grouped by correct source
Read and unread state changes correctly
Dashboard and refresh function start together
Feeds and reading state survive restart
A failed feed does not block valid feed refresh

runtime_requirements: Feeds and read state remain after restart
visual_requirements: Feed list, article list, detail view, and state indicators are usable
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes local storage and network configuration guidance

cases.title: Local REST Service + Dashboard
cases.user_goal: 我想要一个本地运行的小服务，可以通过 API 管理一些记录，同时提供一个简单网页让我查看和编辑，API 和网页必须操作同一份数据。
allowed_assumptions: A simple record domain may be chosen and documented

hard_requirements.description: Create, read, update, and delete records through the API
View and edit records through a browser UI
API and UI operate on the same state
Persist records across restart
Reject malformed API input clearly

hidden_acceptance.description: External HTTP client verifies API CRUD
Malformed API input gets a clear non-success response
Service and dashboard respond locally
API data survives a process restart
API mutations appear in UI and UI mutations appear in API

runtime_requirements: Start a local API and browser UI with documented instructions
visual_requirements: Dashboard supports list, create, edit, errors, and pagination without overlap
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes API examples, setup, and test instructions

cases.title: Customer Feedback Manager
cases.user_goal: 帮我做一个适合小团队使用的客户反馈管理工具。我们平时会收集客户提的问题和建议，希望能整理、跟踪处理情况，以后方便查找。你自己设计第一版。
allowed_assumptions: The product should explain its chosen workflow

hard_requirements.description: Turn the ambiguous goal into a coherent end-to-end feedback workflow
Preserve feedback records and meaningful action state
Provide useful organization and understanding, not storage alone
Enable traceable follow-up actions

hidden_acceptance.description: A dynamic evaluator can complete a coherent feedback-to-action workflow
Organization and insight features add demonstrated value
The chosen product starts and remains usable locally
Feedback and action state survive restart
Collection, understanding, and action states remain connected

runtime_requirements: The evaluator may create an unseen multi-step scenario
visual_requirements: Information hierarchy makes intake, analysis, and action understandable
delivery_requirements: Runnable package includes rationale, setup, and operational guidance
